recs.stt: Case against OOP is understated, not overstated (2020)
recs.x: -- (Even if you don't read this whole comment, I urge you to watch this fantastic video which illustrates procedural, OOP(lite), and FP approaches to a sample problem: [link] (Despite the name, it illustrates JavaScript, not Clojure). If you follow this approach, you don't even have to tell people you are doing FP. You'll just end up with better, more understandable, and more easily testable code.) --

Rant aside, there is a video which I really like that demonstrates this functional core/imperative shell approach: Solving Problems the Clojure Way - Rafal Dittwald. It is a Clojure talk, but it gives an imperative to functional refactor demo in JavaScript in the middle of the talk. Even though it is a toy example, it is big enough that the result shows a meaningful difference in approach.
